Initial release of ima-mcp-cos-upload: Knowledge-base COS direct-upload recipe & full pitfall list.

- Provides a full solution for WordBuddy ima-mcp knowledge base direct-upload to COS, addressing persistent COS 403 errors.
- Documents essential pitfall workarounds for COS signature generation, header value encoding, and file path formatting.
- Shares stable, battle-tested Python implementation for signature construction.
- Offers concrete recommendations for upload workflow, retries, duplicate handling, and credential hygiene, based on real operational lessons.
- Includes detailed troubleshooting for common errors such as signature mismatches and invalid/expired credentials.
- Strongly advises delegating the upload chain to an internal Agent to avoid credential corruption and improve reliability.
